title: HFC phase-down
description: Replace the HFCs in fridges, air conditioners, heat pumps, foams and sprays with gases that warm far less. Stop the HFC-23 released when other chemicals are made.

hfcPhaseDown.title: HFC phase-down
hfcPhaseDown.description: At 100%, the scenario's emissions of every HFC fall by 90%, including the food chain's refrigerants. The Kigali Amendment cuts their use by about 80–85% by the late 2040s. The scenarios already include part of this cut.
